title: Gen-CP
fill_note: DENSE layered wind with a jig; scorer cap 0.65
fill_how: The scored turns assume a dense, layer-by-layer wind at fill 0.65 (insulated-wire area / window; the scorer cap). Use a winding jig on a drill/lathe with a turn counter, lay each layer side-by-side with light back-tension, and do not scramble-wind: a scramble wind only reaches ≈0.55–0.60 and then the window holds fewer turns (scorer what-if `--fill 0.60` is in the table above). Never wind more than the listed turns — the copper must stay below the flanges.
steel_extra: **New steel:** Ø202 discs, M3 clamp map R30 at 0/90/180/270° and R44 on the inter-pole angles 67.5/112.5/247.5/292.5° (both inside the R88 magnet ring). Cut from this kit's `steel_backiron_disc.dxf`; no earlier disc fits.
o5_note: 48 DIAMETRIC Ø5×5 fitted, 3 per inter-pole gap (R80.6/86.8/93), Halbach-oriented (rule engraved on every arc)
card_title: Gen-CP · 8p/12c · T-POLE (N42 crossbar INSIDE the Ø20, 20 mm TANGENTIAL) keyhole
card_sub: Ø20 N52 @R88 + N42 20×10×5 @R72.4 (20 mm tangential) in ONE keyhole pocket · 48 diametric Ø5 · bobbins r58–105.5 × 4.65 mm · 2× Ø202 steel · 2026-10-19
idea: New pole shape, the "T-pole": the Ø20 N52 disc sits OUTSIDE at R88 and its N42 20×10×5 block sits radially INSIDE it but turned with the 20 mm side TANGENTIAL (r67.4–77.4), so each pole is a 20 mm-wide, 36 mm-long radial bar that keeps the full disc width all the way in, instead of narrowing to 10 mm (Gen-CJ/CN radial block). Disc and block share ONE keyhole pocket (0.6 mm apart, no PLA web). The sector bobbins start at r58 (the copper sits on the T, not on the empty hub area) and run to r105.5 with 4.65 mm copper and 294 turns; 48 diametric Ø5 Halbach columns are moved 1.2 mm inward (R80.6/86.8/93.0) to flank the T. Ø202 steel, same Ø229 annular stator / frame as Gen-CJ, one plate.
retro_md:
## Modular notes (Gen-CP)

Same frame-rod circle (R109.5), Ø229 annular stator OD, bearing bridges, standoffs, shaft, collars and gap-sleeve concept as Gen-CJ. New: Ø202 steel discs (clamp ring R88 ±13°), 16 T-pole arcs, stator with bobbins r58–105.5 × 4.65 mm (294 t, 7.25 mm gap sleeve). **Gen-CQ is a drop-in stator swap on these exact rotors** (thin copper, ≈330 m). Gen-CJ's wound bobbins do NOT fit (different radii). Swap stators with the 4 temporary M4 jack rods: raise rotor B on the nuts (clap hazard in reverse, never by hand), swap stator + gap sleeve, lower rotor B, remove the rods.
steel_note: Steel: 2× Ø202 × 4.76 mm (3/16") mild-steel discs, clamp map hub M3 at R22 0/90/180/270°, 4× Ø4.3 brace holes R18 at 45/135/225/315°, 16 arc-clamp M3 at R88 ±13° from every pole, index notch at +X — cut from this kit's `steel_backiron_disc.dxf` (laser-cut service). Lobed arcs: 2.4 mm PLA around each pocket; the epoxy-to-steel bond, not the PLA, holds the magnets. New discs (Gen-CJ's Ø198/R86 discs do not fit).
